Asha (PeopleOps): Hey team — capturing follow-ups from the all‑hands Q&A here. If you asked during the meeting or have a quick follow-up about reviews, leveling, promos, comp, or benefits, drop it below and we'll answer or schedule a short office hour.

Liam (PeopleOps): Quick one — are we doing band range adjustments this cycle or just clarifying leveling criteria? Heard both mentioned.

Priya (Director, Eng): We flagged market band adjustments in leadership sync. The plan: adjust comp bands to market for a subset of levels; leveling criteria (what counts as senior) stays the same. Full writeup later today.

Kai (Manager): For managers running small teams (2–3 ICs), are cross-team calibration meetings still required for promo nominations? Trying to block calendars.

Asha (PeopleOps): Yes — cross-team calibration remains required when anyone is nominated. For teams with fewer promos we allow a short async packet + 15m sync instead of the full 1h if calendars are tight.

Riley (Engineer): Promo timing — if someone is approved in May, when does compensation change hit payroll? Start of next pay period?

Asha (PeopleOps): Standard: promos become effective the next pay period after approvals are fully signed off by Finance. We can make rare retroactive adjustments in special cases but those need a payroll exception and must be submitted before the cutoff. Example: payroll cutoff is 2026-04-20 for May cycle.

HR-Bot: New doc uploaded: https://redwood.company/s/peopleops/promo-process-2026 — includes timeline, checklist, and sample packets.

Liam (PeopleOps): Will managers get a promo packet checklist/template? Makes it easier for consistency.

Asha (PeopleOps): Yes — checklist and a 1‑page template are in the doc. Key required pieces: 1) 3 bullets of impact with metrics, 2) manager rec and calibration notes, 3) peer/skip-level feedback if available. Keep it concise.

Kai (Manager): Any changes to the bonus formula this year? A few folks asked during team retro.

Priya (Director, Eng): No change to company bonus formula this cycle — same performance weights and target multipliers. We'll revisit at Q4 if market conditions shift.

Riley (Engineer): Thanks — that helps. :thumbsup:

Asha (PeopleOps): I'll synthesize a TL;DR and link the updated doc when it's live. Also scheduling a 30‑minute office hours walk‑through next Tue 10:00–10:30 PT to go over the packet + calibration tips. If you want a spot, react with :hand: and we'll add you.

Liam (PeopleOps): Adding the async checklist summary now to the doc so managers can paste into 1:1 notes.

Asha (PeopleOps): Great — will ping again once the public doc + calendar invite are out. Thanks everyone for the quick questions.
